accepted_scope: Standalone Windows PDFium prototype with synthetic OCR. Not adopted into production.
qualified_findings: C15 simulates another thread id for one adapter; per-instance affinity does not serialize different adapters. Do not claim process-wide PDFium thread safety.
Resource close counters verify calls, not OS native-memory leak freedom.
No-persist run skips C19 by flag, not proven filesystem failure. Codex reran path input in an owned fixture directory: 19 passed, zero skipped.

Harness reports write failures and an attempted integrity-label adjustment outside task scope. Codex did not repeat or authorize any ACL/integrity/permission change. Detailed diagnosis remains self-reported.
Real RapidOCR, isolated worker/timeout, text equivalence against PyMuPDF, platform wheels and distribution notices remain unverified.
